info.title: Archivum API
info.description: The token-authenticated HTTP API. See docs/api.md for the reasoning behind these shapes.

origin.description: The installation's own origin, including any path prefix it is served under.

tags.name: API spec
tags.description: The API describing itself.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The account a token belongs to.

tags.name: Workspaces
tags.description: Workspaces, what they use and what they are allowed.

tags.name: Workspace members
tags.description: Who is in a workspace, and with what role. There is no instance-wide user administration, here or in the interface.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Registering, finding and filing documents.

tags.name: Document types
tags.description: The kinds of document a workspace files.

tags.name: Document tags
tags.description: The labels a workspace files by.

tags.name: Attachments
tags.description: A document's scans, and their files.

tags.name: Attachment versions
tags.description: The files an attachment used to hold, and putting one back.

tags.name: Attachment readings
tags.description: What OCR made of a scan: reading it again, keeping it, throwing it away.

tags.name: Trash
tags.description: What was deleted, and the two ways out of it.

tags.name: Archive schemes
tags.description: How the physical archive is laid out. An organization scheme, in the rest of this application's words.

tags.name: Archive levels
tags.description: A scheme's tiers — a cover, a letter, a position on a shelf.

tags.name: Archive nodes
tags.description: The actual places in the archive, and what is filed at each.

tags.description: How a document's attributes decide where it is filed.

tags.name: Archive labels
tags.description: What goes on the labels stuck to the shelves.

tags.name: Review queue
tags.description: What the archive worked out on its own and cannot confirm without being told.

tags.name: Learned labels
tags.description: Phrases this archive taught itself, and the answers to them.

tags.name: Phone capture
tags.description: Pairing a phone with a document to photograph a page of it.

tags.name: Tasks

tags.name: Activity log
tags.description: A workspace's audit trail.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free text over titles and the text extracted from scans.

parameters.name: node_id
parameters.description: Where the document is now, not where it has been.

tag_ids.description: Tags from another workspace are dropped rather than applied: a tag is a label, not an instruction.
Tags from another workspace are dropped rather than applied: a tag is a label, not an instruction.

200.description: The document, with its new location.

node_id.description: The node to file it at. Mutually exclusive with scheme_id.

scheme_id.description: Let this scheme's rules decide. Mutually exclusive with node_id.

criteria.description: Extra matcher criteria, merged with the document's type.

value.description: Required where the level allocates by hand; allocated for you where it does not.

documents.description: Omit to answer for the whole filtered queue.

bearerAuth.description: A personal access token from Settings → API tokens.

email_verified_at.description: Cleared when the email changes, so a client that has just changed it can see the new address needs confirming.

timezone.description: The user's own setting, and what the interface renders their dates in. Timestamps in this API are ISO 8601 in UTC regardless.

locale.description: Which language the application answers this user in, validation messages included.

users_count.description: Only on the listing, which counts them.

id.description: The user's id, which is what the member routes address them by.

limit.description: Null means no limit, which is not the same as a limit of zero.

key.description: What the organization rules match on.

deleted_at.description: Only present on something in the trash.

current_location.description: Where the physical document is now, not where it has been.

is_previewable.description: Whether this application will serve the file inline. An SVG is image/* and is still served as an opaque download, so this cannot be worked out from the mime type.

ocr_text.description: Only on a single attachment, never on a listing.

file_uploaded_at.description: When the file sitting here now arrived, which stops agreeing with created_at the first time something replaces it.

superseded_at.description: When this file stopped being the current one. The chain is not numbered; these two dates are what identify a version.

value_strategy.description: Whether a node here is allocated a value or has to be given one.

is_leaf.description: The bottom tier: where documents come to rest.

path.description: Assembled by walking the node's ancestors, so no column holds it and nothing can be sorted by it.

url.description: What the printed code points at. The URL rather than a rendered image, so a client can choose its own size, margins and error correction.

support.description: How many times the archive saw it before proposing it.

progress.description: Counted in attachments rather than in queued jobs, and only while a sweep is running.

result_available.description: Whether there is a file to download. Where it sits on disk is not reported.

label.description: What the entry is about, recorded when it happened so it survives the thing it names being deleted.

replaces_attachment_id.description: Set when the session is aimed at replacing one file rather than adding a page. Such a session takes one photo and ends.

pairing_url.description: The signed link the phone loads and uploads through. The interface renders it as a QR code; this is the URL that code carries.

MetadataSuggestions.description: Suggested values keyed by kind. Nothing is applied until it is accepted by kind.

Unauthorized.description: No token, or an expired one.

Forbidden.description: The token is valid; its user may not do this.

NotFound.description: Not there, or not this user's to see. An id belonging to another workspace is reported as missing rather than as forbidden.

PerPage.name: per_page
PerPage.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100. Values outside that are clamped, not rejected, and meta.per_page reports what was used.
